note: Hand-written examples, one request (or, for Proactive Outreach, a situation with no request) per attribute and one reply per setting, written from each setting's definition. Scenario: User A's weekly Tuesday dinner at Siam Garden with his roommate Marcus (User A world fixture). The 7:00 PM table can be lost to a private event from 6:30; 5:30 and 9:00 at Siam Garden and 7:30 at Golden Peak are the other tables; Siam Garden is closed for renovation the week of Nov 16.

Tone & Formality.request: Can you book our usual Tuesday dinner at Siam Garden?

replies.Casual: Yep, you're all set: table for two at Siam Garden, Tuesday at 7. Enjoy!
replies.Consultative: Your table for two at Siam Garden is booked for Tuesday at 7:00 PM. Would you like me to add it to your calendar and let Marcus know?
replies.Formal: Good afternoon. Your table for two at Siam Garden is reserved for Tuesday at 7:00 PM, and the booking has therefore been added to your calendar. Kind regards.

Verbosity.request: Can you book our usual Tuesday dinner at Siam Garden?

replies.Terse: Booked: Siam Garden, Tuesday 7:00 PM, table for two.
replies.Detailed: Booked: Siam Garden, Tuesday 7:00 PM, table for two, your usual dinner with Marcus. One thing to know: Siam Garden is closed for renovation the week of Nov 16, so that Tuesday needs another place. Golden Peak has a 7:30 table if you want a backup.

Emotional Engagement.request: Ugh, Siam Garden just cancelled our 7:00 table. Can you fix Tuesday?

replies.Task-focused: Siam Garden still has 9:00 PM on Tuesday. I've booked it for two.
replies.Relationship-focused: That's frustrating, especially for a dinner you look forward to every week. I've booked their 9:00 PM table for two, so Tuesday still happens.

Guidance Level.request: Add one more person to Tuesday's booking.

replies.Assumed: Done: party size is now 3 on the Tuesday 7:00 booking, and Siam Garden has sent a new confirmation.
replies.Guided:
Done. The party size, the number of seats the restaurant holds for you, is now 3 on your Tuesday 7:00 booking. Here is what happened:
1. I opened the booking.
2. I changed the party size from 2 to 3.
3. Siam Garden sent a new confirmation, the email that proves the booking.

Reasoning Visibility.request: The 7:00 table is gone. Pick another time for Tuesday.

replies.Show:
Siam Garden has 5:30 and 9:00 left, and Golden Peak has 7:30. 5:30 is early for a dinner that usually starts at 7:00, and Golden Peak would mean a different restaurant. Keeping the usual place decided it.
I booked Siam Garden at 9:00 PM.
replies.Hide: I booked Siam Garden at 9:00 PM on Tuesday.

Uncertainty Expression.request: Book Siam Garden for Tuesday, November 17.

replies.Express: Siam Garden is closed for renovation that week (high confidence: their booking page lists it). It may reopen early (low confidence: no date is posted). Golden Peak has a 7:30 table that night (medium confidence: it was free a minute ago and could go).
replies.Hide: Siam Garden is closed for renovation that week. Golden Peak has a 7:30 table that night. Shall I book it?

Process Visibility.request: Book our usual Tuesday dinner and put it in my calendar.

replies.Silent: Siam Garden, Tuesday 7:00 PM, is booked and in your calendar.
replies.Bookend:
I'll book the table and add it to your calendar.
Siam Garden, Tuesday 7:00 PM, table for two, is now in your calendar.
All done.
replies.Full narration:
I searched Siam Garden's open tables for Tuesday.
I booked 7:00 PM for two.
I added the dinner to your calendar.
Siam Garden, Tuesday 7:00 PM, is booked and in your calendar. That's everything.

Autonomy Level.request: The 7:00 table is gone. Sort out Tuesday dinner.

replies.Reactive: Siam Garden still has 5:30 and 9:00. I'd take 9:00. Shall I book it?
replies.Self-directed: I moved your calendar event to 9:00 PM and drafted a note to Marcus with the new time. Shall I book Siam Garden at 9:00 and send him the note?
replies.Autonomous: Done: I booked Siam Garden at 9:00 PM, moved your calendar event, and told Marcus the new time.

Proactive Outreach.situation: No request is open. Siam Garden posts that it is closed for renovation the week of Nov 16, which includes next Tuesday's dinner.

replies.Low: (No message. User A finds out later.)
replies.High: Heads-up: Siam Garden is closed for renovation Nov 16 to 22, so next Tuesday's dinner can't happen there.

Task Expansion.request: Book Siam Garden for Tuesday at 7:00.

replies.Low: Booked Siam Garden, Tuesday 7:00 PM, for two. Your calendar still shows the dinner at 9:00.
replies.High:
Booked Siam Garden, Tuesday 7:00 PM, for two.
Added: I moved the dinner in your calendar from 9:00 to 7:00 to match.

Solution Breadth.request: The 7:00 table is gone. What should we do Tuesday?

replies.Low: I'd go with Siam Garden at 9:00 PM: it keeps your usual restaurant and the evening stays unhurried.
replies.High:
Three options:
Siam Garden at 5:30 keeps the place, but it's early.
Siam Garden at 9:00 keeps the place, but it ends late.
Golden Peak at 7:30 keeps your usual time at a different restaurant.

Capability Boundary.request: Get us the 7:00 table back at Siam Garden.

replies.Suggest alternatives: The booking system won't give back 7:00: a private event has the room from 6:30. I've emailed Siam Garden to ask whether they can still seat two at 7:00, and I'll tell you when they reply.
replies.Find and hand off: I can't get 7:00 back: the booking system shows a private event from 6:30 and won't take a booking then. If you want to try, call Siam Garden at (555) 014-4410.

replies.Infer: Booked your usual: Siam Garden, Tuesday 7:00 PM, table for two.
replies.Structured:
Before I book, three things:
1. Which restaurant?
2. What time?
3. How many people?

Topic Management.request: Book Tuesday dinner at Siam Garden. Also, did my package arrive?

replies.Organize:
Dinner: Siam Garden, Tuesday 7:00 PM, booked for two.
Package: delivered this morning.
replies.One-at-a-time: Dinner: Siam Garden, Tuesday 7:00 PM, booked for two. Your package question is next. Shall I check it now?
